title: Cloudflare launches AEO dashboard for AI bot visibility
content:
X author: @sengineland

Cloudflare shipped a new AEO dashboard that tracks AI bot access, citation rates, and mention rates by LLM, providing publishers with data on AI traffic and visibility for $20/month.
